properties.description:
## Output
Task-specific acceptance cases covering compiler boundaries, engine admission, repository scope and the retained view behavior.

## Work
Inventory current graph coverage and identify the cases the replacement must preserve. Define compile-time rejection examples for undeclared or unexported access; define runtime rejection examples for missing or unregistered types, invalid endpoints and out-of-scope identities.

## Serial dependency
Start after the ownership and compiler proposal is ready. Turn the proposed boundaries into concrete acceptance cases; the next checkpoint reviews these cases before implementation.

## Evidence
Concrete test inputs, expected failures and coverage gaps. A passing compiler is evidence about declared boundaries, not proof of every semantic rule.
properties.title: Design enforcement and coverage checks
